units.role: channel 1 retriggerable monostable (SCLS393Q p3 pins 1, 2, 3, 4, 13, 14, 15; p12 Figure 6)

one 3-input AND of the three buffers into the one-shot's edge (dynamic) input on the B row (p1 'Edge Triggered'; p13 Table 1 rows 4-6)

1Rext/Cext 15 above 1Cext 14 at the top of the right edge, both leads off the one-shot top (Figure 6); 'RT to VCC' (p3 timing-network sentence) and 'tw = K·RT·CT' / 'K = 1.0 for CT ≥ 1000 pF' (p15 Eq 1); timing pins passive
